editorial:
You follow Pete Koslow, a former convict trying to rebuild his life in New York while secretly working as an informant for the FBI. He is stuck between Klimek the General, his ruthless Polish mafia boss, and two federal agents who have their own twisted plans. The tension never really lets up, and you feel Pete's stress as every choice puts his family in danger. The story keeps you guessing about who is really on his side.

The acting is strong, especially the lead performance, and the action scenes feel grounded and real. The pacing moves quickly, though some side plots feel a bit rushed. If you enjoy crime thrillers with moral gray areas, this one is worth your time. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Pete realizes both federal agents have been using him for their own gain. He turns the tables by exposing their corruption and the mafia's operations at the same time. Klimek the General is taken down, and Pete manages to protect his wife and daughter. The movie ends with Pete finally free from both the mafia and the FBI, walking away with his family safe.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves crime thrillers with moral gray areas and undercover stories.
